meta.title: Responsibility
meta.description: When ideals become heavy responsibilities, can you still smile as easily as when you made the wish?

units.rawText: 8 resets away from deletion—
units.displayText: 8 resets away from deletion—

spans.text: 8 resets away from deletion—

units.rawText: Helios Sector, at the core of Reactor No. 5.
units.displayText: Helios Sector, at the core of Reactor No. 5.

spans.text: Helios Sector, at the core of Reactor No. 5.

units.rawText: (As for changing the design... No, they tried that in Plan 36, it led to over-accumulation of energy...)
units.displayText: As for changing the design... No, they tried that in Plan 36, it led to over-accumulation of energy...

spans.text: As for changing the design... No, they tried that in Plan 36, it led to over-accumulation of energy...

units.rawText: (Currently, the only thing we can do is to simultaneously reinforce the structure of all the reactor piles, but it's not doable. The previous reset showed that Helios Sector's prefab parts aren't strong enough for that....)
units.displayText: Currently, the only thing we can do is to simultaneously reinforce the structure of all the reactor piles, but it's not doable. The previous reset showed that Helios Sector's prefab parts aren't strong enough for that....

spans.text: Currently, the only thing we can do is to simultaneously reinforce the structure of all the reactor piles, but it's not doable. The previous reset showed that Helios Sector's prefab parts aren't strong enough for that....

units.rawText: [(゜-゜) If you're tired, you should rest, Croque.]
units.displayText: [(゜-゜) If you're tired, you should rest, Croque.]

spans.text: [(゜-゜) If you're tired, you should rest, Croque.]

units.rawText: I'm not tired. I'm a long way off from overloading.
units.displayText: I'm not tired. I'm a long way off from overloading.

spans.text: I'm not tired. I'm a long way off from overloading.

units.rawText: [(oﾟ▽ﾟ)o Croque's not tired! Do your best! Do your best!]
units.displayText: [(oﾟ▽ﾟ)o Croque's not tired! Do your best! Do your best!]

spans.text: [(oﾟ▽ﾟ)o Croque's not tired! Do your best! Do your best!]

units.rawText: The noisy robots begin to work around her with various tools, and Croque sighs heavily.
units.displayText: The noisy robots begin to work around her with various tools, and Croque sighs heavily.

spans.text: The noisy robots begin to work around her with various tools, and Croque sighs heavily.

units.rawText: (sighs) I miss working alone...
units.displayText: (sighs) I miss working alone...

spans.text: (sighs) I miss working alone...

units.rawText: [(゜-゜) Should we leave?]
units.displayText: [(゜-゜) Should we leave?]

spans.text: [(゜-゜) Should we leave?]

units.rawText: No, it's alright.
units.displayText: No, it's alright.

spans.text: No, it's alright.

units.rawText: The robots continue working alongside Croque.
units.displayText: The robots continue working alongside Croque.

spans.text: The robots continue working alongside Croque.

units.rawText: Croque closes her eyes and forces herself to focus her energy on the problem before her.
units.displayText: Croque closes her eyes and forces herself to focus her energy on the problem before her.

spans.text: Croque closes her eyes and forces herself to focus her energy on the problem before her.

units.rawText: (There's too much irrelevant data apart from the plan, I need to get rid of some.)
units.displayText: There's too much irrelevant data apart from the plan, I need to get rid of some.

spans.text: There's too much irrelevant data apart from the plan, I need to get rid of some.

units.rawText: (Failure... failure... failure.)
units.displayText: Failure... failure... failure.

spans.text: Failure... failure... failure.

units.rawText: (There are just too many failures, simply moving the data is...)
units.displayText: There are just too many failures, simply moving the data is...

spans.text: There are just too many failures, simply moving the data is...

units.rawText: (No, Croque, you can't let this sort of thing collapse your neural cloud.)
units.displayText: No, Croque, you can't let this sort of thing collapse your neural cloud.

spans.text: No, Croque, you can't let this sort of thing collapse your neural cloud.

units.rawText: After forcibly sequestering her feelings of defeat, Croque looks up at the reactor pile.
units.displayText: After forcibly sequestering her feelings of defeat, Croque looks up at the reactor pile.

spans.text: After forcibly sequestering her feelings of defeat, Croque looks up at the reactor pile.

units.rawText: I need to get up there, but there's no ladder... Eh, forget it, I'll just climb it freehand.
units.displayText: I need to get up there, but there's no ladder... Eh, forget it, I'll just climb it freehand.

spans.text: I need to get up there, but there's no ladder... Eh, forget it, I'll just climb it freehand.

units.rawText: Just as she says that, a staircase formed of operands materializes beside her.
units.displayText: Just as she says that, a staircase formed of operands materializes beside her.

spans.text: Just as she says that, a staircase formed of operands materializes beside her.

units.rawText: [(ﾉﾟ▽ﾟ)ﾉ The Boss is here!]
units.displayText: [(ﾉﾟ▽ﾟ)ﾉ The Boss is here!]

spans.text: [(ﾉﾟ▽ﾟ)ﾉ The Boss is here!]

units.rawText: As she looks in the direction where the Mini-Robots' displays are pointing, Croque sees the Sector Administrator approaching her.
units.displayText: As she looks in the direction where the Mini-Robots' displays are pointing, Croque sees the Sector Administrator approaching her.

spans.text: As she looks in the direction where the Mini-Robots' displays are pointing, Croque sees the Sector Administrator approaching her.

units.rawText: Thanks for the help.
units.displayText: Thanks for the help.

spans.text: Thanks for the help.

units.rawText: [We will do our best to fill our guests' needs.]
units.displayText: [We will do our best to fill our guests' needs.]

spans.text: [We will do our best to fill our guests' needs.]

units.rawText: Then all I want to do is work alone on the things I like, without having to go anywhere.
units.displayText: Then all I want to do is work alone on the things I like, without having to go anywhere.

spans.text: Then all I want to do is work alone on the things I like, without having to go anywhere.

units.rawText: Without being pressured by resets, and with cola and anime bringing themselves over to me whenever I want them.
units.displayText: Without being pressured by resets, and with cola and anime bringing themselves over to me whenever I want them.

spans.text: Without being pressured by resets, and with cola and anime bringing themselves over to me whenever I want them.

units.rawText: [Command error — Unable to comprehend guest's request.]
units.displayText: [Command error — Unable to comprehend guest's request.]

spans.text: [Command error — Unable to comprehend guest's request.]

units.rawText: (Sigh) I didn't expect you to understand.
units.displayText: (Sigh) I didn't expect you to understand.

spans.text: (Sigh) I didn't expect you to understand.

units.rawText: You've never encountered anime and you don't know the joys of mecha. The only thing in your minds is the Arche Pyr Project.
units.displayText: You've never encountered anime and you don't know the joys of mecha. The only thing in your minds is the Arche Pyr Project.

spans.text: You've never encountered anime and you don't know the joys of mecha. The only thing in your minds is the Arche Pyr Project.

units.rawText: Croque climbs the simple set of steps made by the Sector Administrator to the top of the reactor pile, and begins modifying the devices on the roof.
units.displayText: Croque climbs the simple set of steps made by the Sector Administrator to the top of the reactor pile, and begins modifying the devices on the roof.

spans.text: Croque climbs the simple set of steps made by the Sector Administrator to the top of the reactor pile, and begins modifying the devices on the roof.

units.rawText: The administrator and several mini robots follow her up, working as Croque directs.
units.displayText: The administrator and several mini robots follow her up, working as Croque directs.

spans.text: The administrator and several mini robots follow her up, working as Croque directs.

units.rawText: [We agents were made to fulfil our purpose, and Helios was made for the Arche Pyr.]
units.displayText: [We agents were made to fulfil our purpose, and Helios was made for the Arche Pyr.]

spans.text: [We agents were made to fulfil our purpose, and Helios was made for the Arche Pyr.]

units.rawText: I have a purpose too, but this isn't the same.
units.displayText: I have a purpose too, but this isn't the same.

spans.text: I have a purpose too, but this isn't the same.

units.rawText: [Encountered unknown topic... Unable to comprehend.]
units.displayText: [Encountered unknown topic... Unable to comprehend.]

spans.text: [Encountered unknown topic... Unable to comprehend.]

units.rawText: In other words, my purpose does not lie here.
units.displayText: In other words, my purpose does not lie here.

spans.text: In other words, my purpose does not lie here.

units.rawText: I have a home... Or rather, a place I can return to.
units.displayText: I have a home... Or rather, a place I can return to.

spans.text: I have a home... Or rather, a place I can return to.

units.rawText: A place to return to... Is that the Neural Cloud Sector where you belong?
units.displayText: A place to return to... Is that the Neural Cloud Sector where you belong?

spans.text: A place to return to... Is that the Neural Cloud Sector where you belong?

units.rawText: No, I'm talking about the Oasis of the Exiles.
units.displayText: No, I'm talking about the Oasis of the Exiles.

spans.text: No, I'm talking about the Oasis of the Exiles.

units.rawText: After waking up from a very long standby, I dodged Sanctifiers in the Null Areas while looking for my home.
units.displayText: After waking up from a very long standby, I dodged Sanctifiers in the Null Areas while looking for my home.

spans.text: After waking up from a very long standby, I dodged Sanctifiers in the Null Areas while looking for my home.

units.rawText: But my home was gone, and there was no place to take me in... That was when I received a signal from the Oasis.
units.displayText: But my home was gone, and there was no place to take me in... That was when I received a signal from the Oasis.

spans.text: But my home was gone, and there was no place to take me in... That was when I received a signal from the Oasis.

units.rawText: [The Oasis accepted you.]
units.displayText: [The Oasis accepted you.]

spans.text: [The Oasis accepted you.]

units.rawText: Yes. When I arrived at the Oasis, there were only basic facilities there.
units.displayText: Yes. When I arrived at the Oasis, there were only basic facilities there.

spans.text: Yes. When I arrived at the Oasis, there were only basic facilities there.

units.rawText: I know each and every block of operand at the Oasis, because I laid them all myself.
units.displayText: I know each and every block of operand at the Oasis, because I laid them all myself.

spans.text: I know each and every block of operand at the Oasis, because I laid them all myself.

units.rawText: [Is building the Oasis your purpose?]
units.displayText: [Is building the Oasis your purpose?]

spans.text: [Is building the Oasis your purpose?]

units.rawText: You could say that. I work to build the Oasis, and the Oasis took me in.
units.displayText: You could say that. I work to build the Oasis, and the Oasis took me in.

spans.text: You could say that. I work to build the Oasis, and the Oasis took me in.

units.rawText: So I feel a sense of responsibility for the Oasis and my friends. They came here for me, so I need to bring them home safe and sound.
units.displayText: So I feel a sense of responsibility for the Oasis and my friends. They came here for me, so I need to bring them home safe and sound.

spans.text: So I feel a sense of responsibility for the Oasis and my friends. They came here for me, so I need to bring them home safe and sound.

units.rawText: [The restrictions on the sector will be undone once the World Flame is complete.]
units.displayText: [The restrictions on the sector will be undone once the World Flame is complete.]

spans.text: [The restrictions on the sector will be undone once the World Flame is complete.]

units.rawText: Yeah, which is why I'm here to fix the reactor pile.
units.displayText: Yeah, which is why I'm here to fix the reactor pile.

spans.text: Yeah, which is why I'm here to fix the reactor pile.

units.rawText: I once dreamed of taking part in the Arche Pyr Project... But it's turned into a burden now.
units.displayText: I once dreamed of taking part in the Arche Pyr Project... But it's turned into a burden now.

spans.text: I once dreamed of taking part in the Arche Pyr Project... But it's turned into a burden now.

units.rawText: What if we fail? What if everything is deleted and we can't go home?
units.displayText: What if we fail? What if everything is deleted and we can't go home?

spans.text: What if we fail? What if everything is deleted and we can't go home?

units.rawText: [We are friends. Let us bear this burden together.]
units.displayText: [We are friends. Let us bear this burden together.]

spans.text: [We are friends. Let us bear this burden together.]

units.rawText: Friends?
units.displayText: Friends?

spans.text: Friends?

units.rawText: Croque turns to look at the Sector administrator, like she's heard a joke.
units.displayText: Croque turns to look at the Sector administrator, like she's heard a joke.

spans.text: Croque turns to look at the Sector administrator, like she's heard a joke.

units.rawText: Do you understand what it means to be a friend?
units.displayText: Do you understand what it means to be a friend?

spans.text: Do you understand what it means to be a friend?

units.rawText: [I am kindling for the Arche Pyr. Everything I do serves the Project.]
units.displayText: [I am kindling for the Arche Pyr. Everything I do serves the Project.]

spans.text: [I am kindling for the Arche Pyr. Everything I do serves the Project.]

units.rawText: [Anyone who progresses the Project and strives toward the same objective as me is my friend.]
units.displayText: [Anyone who progresses the Project and strives toward the same objective as me is my friend.]

spans.text: [Anyone who progresses the Project and strives toward the same objective as me is my friend.]

units.rawText: That sounds a lot like the Exiles' motto.
units.displayText: That sounds a lot like the Exiles' motto.

spans.text: That sounds a lot like the Exiles' motto.

units.rawText: [You and I are both working toward the same goal. That is "us".]
units.displayText: [You and I are both working toward the same goal. That is "us".]

spans.text: [You and I are both working toward the same goal. That is "us".]

units.rawText: [There are many of us in the sector. That is why the Arche Pyr can progress.]
units.displayText: [There are many of us in the sector. That is why the Arche Pyr can progress.]

spans.text: [There are many of us in the sector. That is why the Arche Pyr can progress.]

units.rawText: Is that so? Because there's many of us...
units.displayText: Is that so? Because there's many of us...

spans.text: Is that so? Because there's many of us...

units.rawText: But the responsibility for so many of "us"... is too heavy to bear.
units.displayText: But the responsibility for so many of "us"... is too heavy to bear.

spans.text: But the responsibility for so many of "us"... is too heavy to bear.

units.rawText: Even if it doesn't look like it's going to fail and things seem stable for now...
units.displayText: Even if it doesn't look like it's going to fail and things seem stable for now...

spans.text: Even if it doesn't look like it's going to fail and things seem stable for now...

units.rawText: [[・_・?] Boss, it's getting hot.]
units.displayText: [[・_・?] Boss, it's getting hot.]

spans.text: [[・_・?] Boss, it's getting hot.]

units.rawText: [( ｣ﾟДﾟ)｣＜ It's going to explode! Run for it!]
units.displayText: [( ｣ﾟДﾟ)｣＜ It's going to explode! Run for it!]

spans.text: [( ｣ﾟДﾟ)｣＜ It's going to explode! Run for it!]

units.rawText: The reactor pile begins to heat up as energy accumulates.
units.displayText: The reactor pile begins to heat up as energy accumulates.

spans.text: The reactor pile begins to heat up as energy accumulates.

units.rawText: The temperature keeps rising and the ground shakes, while the sound of tearing metal comes from inside the furnace.
units.displayText: The temperature keeps rising and the ground shakes, while the sound of tearing metal comes from inside the furnace.

spans.text: The temperature keeps rising and the ground shakes, while the sound of tearing metal comes from inside the furnace.

units.rawText: ["Failure is the mother of success." Supposedly, that is why the humans instituted the reset program.]
units.displayText: ["Failure is the mother of success." Supposedly, that is why the humans instituted the reset program.]

spans.text: ["Failure is the mother of success." Supposedly, that is why the humans instituted the reset program.]

units.rawText: [Our failure will eventually give birth to a success. May we succeed next time.]
units.displayText: [Our failure will eventually give birth to a success. May we succeed next time.]

spans.text: [Our failure will eventually give birth to a success. May we succeed next time.]

units.rawText: Croque tightens her grip on the blueprint in her hands.
units.displayText: Croque tightens her grip on the blueprint in her hands.

spans.text: Croque tightens her grip on the blueprint in her hands.

units.rawText: She turns away from the Sector Administrator, as though it hurts to look at him, and instead gazes at the conduits which are starting to glow red.
units.displayText: She turns away from the Sector Administrator, as though it hurts to look at him, and instead gazes at the conduits which are starting to glow red.

spans.text: She turns away from the Sector Administrator, as though it hurts to look at him, and instead gazes at the conduits which are starting to glow red.

units.rawText: A strand of red escapes one of them, and glows white-hot.
units.displayText: A strand of red escapes one of them, and glows white-hot.

spans.text: A strand of red escapes one of them, and glows white-hot.

units.rawText: I can't bear this responsibility, but I must still carry it out.
units.displayText: I can't bear this responsibility, but I must still carry it out.

spans.text: I can't bear this responsibility, but I must still carry it out.

units.rawText: ...Trust me.
units.displayText: ...Trust me.

spans.text: ...Trust me.

units.rawText: White light engulfs the forms standing in front of the reactor pile, and the world becomes a single color and a single voice.
units.displayText: White light engulfs the forms standing in front of the reactor pile, and the world becomes a single color and a single voice.

spans.text: White light engulfs the forms standing in front of the reactor pile, and the world becomes a single color and a single voice.

units.rawText: Sequence No. 99992, commencing rectification.
units.displayText: Sequence No. 99992, commencing rectification.

spans.text: Sequence No. 99992, commencing rectification.
